sec.title: 2.2. Cell Culture and Transfection
sec.p: HeLa cells were obtained from the Korean Cell Line Bank (KCLB, Seoul, Republic of Korea; KCLB No. 10002). HeLa cells were cultured in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS & 1% penicillin[1].
A549 cells were maintained in RPMI medium supplemented with 5% FBS.
